item.title: Troops arrest suspected suicide bomber, seize IED materials in Borno
item.description: Troops of Operation Hadin Kai have arrested a suspected suicide bomber and intercepted materials intended for the production of Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs) in Borno State. item.title: Katsina: NSCDC arrests 2,088 suspects, recovers over N56m
item.description: Katsina Command of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps, NSCDC, has arrested 2,088 criminal suspects and recovered more than N56.6 million during 2025, the State Commandant, Mr Abbas Moriki, has disclosed. item.title: Police arrest 22-year-old suspect over alleged rape of minor in Oyo
item.description: Oyo State Police Command has confirmed the arrest of a 22-year-old man, Daniel Ajibola, in connection with the alleged rape of a 17-year-old girl in Ibadan. item.title: Condemnations as Nasarawa youths trek miles to display support for politicians
item.description: Ahead of the 2027 general elections, youths in Nasarawa State have taken to trekking long distances in solidarity with politicians just as campaign season approaches. The practice, while intended to show support, has raised questions about the welfare of the young participants and the broader implications for the future of political engagement in the state.
